TimePickerRoot.description: Holds the picker's time and open state and shares them, with `min`, `max`, `locale`, `granularity`, the steps and the rest, with the parts inside it. Renders no element.

props.value: The time, a `Temporal.PlainTime`. Pass it with `onValueChange` to control the picker; `null` is controlled and empty, and leaving it out (or `undefined`) lets the picker hold its own value. It may be read from an answer that is loading or guessed over; one that fails is left to the app's `errored` region.
props.defaultValue: The time at first, when the picker isn't controlled. A form reset puts it back.
props.onValueChange: Called with the time for each choice in the popup and each complete time typed in the field, and with `undefined` when the field becomes incomplete. It is called in a change of its own, so it may save without holding the picker.
props.open: Whether the popup is open. Pass it with `onOpenChange` to control it. Escape and a press outside can't be refused: a popup kept open is shown again.
props.defaultOpen: Whether the popup is open at first, when it isn't controlled.
props.onOpenChange: Called after the popup opens or closes, in a change of its own.
props.min: The earliest valid time. Options before it are disabled, a choice is clamped to it, and an earlier time typed in the field marks it invalid (`rangeUnderflow`).
props.max: The latest valid time. Options after it are disabled, a choice is clamped to it, and a later time typed in the field marks it invalid (`rangeOverflow`).
props.locale: The locale of the field's segments and the options' text: digits, day period names and hour cycle.
props.granularity: The smallest unit: `"hour"`, `"minute"` or `"second"`. TimePickerSeconds renders only at `"second"`, TimePickerMinutes not at `"hour"`.
props.hourCycle: `12` or `24` overrides the locale's hour cycle; TimePickerDayPeriod renders only in 12-hour time.
props.minuteStep: Minutes between the minute column's options. It shapes the list, not the value: a time typed off the step is valid and selects no minute.
props.secondStep: Seconds between the second column's options.
props.placeholderValue: What a choice in a column starts from while there is no value (and what an empty segment steps from). Without it, a choice starts from the time the popup opened at.
props.disabled: Whether the picker can't be changed: the field is disabled and the trigger is a disabled button. Also true inside a disabled FieldRoot.
props.readOnly: Whether the field can be focused but not changed. The trigger is disabled, so the popup doesn't open.
props.required: Whether a time is needed for the form to be valid.
props.name: The name the field's hidden input submits the time under (`13:45`, or `13:45:00` with `granularity="second"`). Taken from an enclosing FieldRoot when not given.
props.form: The id of a `<form>` the hidden input belongs to, when the picker isn't inside it.
props.invalid: For a composition that keeps the Field to itself (Time Range Picker): marks the field and every segment invalid. Given, it wins over an enclosing FieldRoot's state; a time outside `min`/`max` is invalid either way.
props.describedBy: For a composition: the ids each segment's `aria-describedby` gets (a Field's description and error). Given, it wins over an enclosing FieldRoot's.
props.onIncompleteChange: For a composition: called with whether the field is partly filled, whenever that changes.

TimePickerField.description: The field: a TimeFieldRoot given the picker's value, bounds, locale, name and state, so it is a `role="group"` named by its `aria-label`, `aria-labelledby` or an enclosing FieldLabel. Inside it go Time Field's own parts (TimeFieldInput and a TimeFieldSegment per entry of `use timeField`'s `segments`) and usually the trigger. Its hidden `<input type="time">` is the only one the picker submits.

props.emptyText: What an empty segment's `aria-valuetext` says, in the app's language.
props.incompleteMessage: The validation message while some segments are filled and others not.

dataAttributes.data-disabled: Present when the picker is disabled.
dataAttributes.data-readonly: Present when the picker is read-only.
dataAttributes.data-required: Present when the picker is required.
dataAttributes.data-invalid: Present when the time is outside `min`/`max`, or the FieldRoot around it is invalid.
dataAttributes.data-focused: Present while one of the field's segments has focus.

TimePickerTrigger.description: The button that opens and closes the popup, through the browser's `popovertarget`. `aria-haspopup="dialog"`; named "Choose time" unless given `aria-label`. Disabled while the picker is disabled or read-only.

dataAttributes.data-popup-open: Present while the popup is open.
dataAttributes.data-disabled: Present when the picker is disabled.
dataAttributes.data-readonly: Present when the picker is read-only.

TimePickerPopup.description: The popup: a `popover="auto"` element placed against the trigger with CSS anchor positioning, `role="dialog"`, named "Choose time" unless given `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby`. It closes on Escape, a press outside, Enter on an option, and focus leaving it. Style it with `:popover-open` and `@starting-style`, not a `display` rule.

props.alignOffset: Shift along the trigger's edge, in pixels.

dataAttributes.data-side: The side of the trigger the popup is on, after any flip.

TimePickerHours.description: The hours column, a listbox: 0–23, or in 12-hour time the 12 hours of the value's day period. Opening scrolls it to the selected hour and focuses it. Its options are `role="option"` elements with `data-selected` and `data-disabled`, styled through the column. Named "Hours" unless given `aria-label`.

dataAttributes.data-disabled: Present when the picker is disabled.

TimePickerMinutes.description: The minutes column, a listbox of the minutes every `minuteStep`. Renders nothing with `granularity="hour"`. Named "Minutes" unless given `aria-label`.

dataAttributes.data-disabled: Present when the picker is disabled.

TimePickerSeconds.description: The seconds column, a listbox of the seconds every `secondStep`. Renders nothing unless `granularity="second"`. Named "Seconds" unless given `aria-label`.

dataAttributes.data-disabled: Present when the picker is disabled.

TimePickerDayPeriod.description: The AM/PM column, in the locale's words. Renders nothing in 24-hour time. Choosing one keeps the hour on the clock face (9:30 AM becomes 9:30 PM). Named "AM/PM" unless given `aria-label`.

dataAttributes.data-disabled: Present when the picker is disabled.

TimePickerOptions.description: The other popup design: one listbox of whole times every `interval` minutes from midnight (09:00, 09:30 …), those outside `min` and `max` disabled. Any choice (a click, Enter or Space) sets the whole time and closes the popup. Long interval lists render nearby groups of options as you scroll. Home, End, arrow keys and typeahead still reach the whole list. Named "Times" unless given `aria-label`.

dataAttributes.data-disabled: Present when the picker is disabled.
dataAttributes.data-target: The option it opens on when none is selected: the one nearest the time it starts from.
